chunks: Abu al-Qasim Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from some of his men, from Harun ibn Harizah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

"When it is the night of the middle of Sha'ban, a caller from the highest horizon calls out: 'O visitors of al-Husayn, return; your reward is forgiven, your recompense is with your Lord and Muhammad, your Prophet.'

key_terms.لَيْلَةُ النِّصْفِ مِنْ شَعْبَانَ: The night of the middle of the month of Sha'ban

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the night of the 15th of Sha'ban for visitors of Imam al-Husayn?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the unique spiritual status of Laylat al-Nisf min Sha'ban as a night of divine proclamation, specifically linking the intercession of Imam al-Husayn (AS) to the forgiveness of his devotees. The 'caller from the highest horizon' (al-Ufuq al-A'la) signifies a celestial event that validates the merit of Ziyarat, suggesting that devotion to the grandson of the Prophet secures a direct, forgiven reward from Allah and the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).
